questions.why: Complementary colours are opposite each other on the colour wheel: blue and orange.

options: A colour mixed with its complement
questions.why: Tint is colour plus white; shade is colour plus black.

questions.q: Which medium is opaque, water-based and gives flat matte areas of colour?
questions.why: Gouache is opaque water-based paint; watercolour is transparent.

questions.q: Describe the wet-on-wet technique in watercolour.
questions.model: Apply wet paint onto wet paper or wet paint so the colours spread and blend softly. It suits skies and misty effects.
